character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Pixel art character sprite of a Mega-level golden beast knight warrior inspired by CresGarurumon, poised battle-ready three-quarter combat stance.

Visual Design:
- Body & Armor: Slender yet powerful humanoid knight clad in ornate, highly reflective golden Chrome Digizoid plate armor with royal purple inner cloth/joint padding and glowing cyan filigree accents.
- Head & Helm: Elegant golden wolf-headed knight helm crowned with sweeping gold wolf ears, a sharp silver muzzle visor, glowing crimson eyes, and a long flowing silver-white fur mane trailing down the back.
- Main Weapon (Yellow Beast Crescent Blade): Wielding a massive two-handed golden polearm / naginata with a giant curved glowing cyan energy blade and ornate wolf crest carvings on the hilt.
- Shoulders & Back: Curved golden wolf-head pauldrons with purple accents, paired with a pair of golden blade-like armor wings/sheaths attached to the back harness.
- Legs & Boots: Articulated golden greaves with pointed knee guards, purple trim, and claw-tipped armored sabatons.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- Sharp high-contrast metallic gold reflections, luminous cyan energy glow, clean dark pixel contours.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
